121.option_a_cn: 先给小团队试管一周期，并配导师与隔级复盘
121.option_a_en: Run a one-cycle small-team trial with mentoring and skip-level review
121.option_b_cn: 直接授予大团队正式管理权，只看首周期结果定去留
121.option_b_en: Grant full control of a large team and judge only the first cycle

122.option_a_cn: 按四成结果、三成人才、三成过程留证打分
122.option_a_en: Score documented results, talent stewardship, and management process at 40-30-30
122.option_b_cn: 把当期硬结果提到绝对多数，流失与反馈债以后再算
122.option_b_en: Let current hard results dominate and defer turnover and feedback debt

123.option_a_cn: 用六项专表收集下属评价，并按评价者可信度校正
123.option_a_en: Collect six manager-specific dimensions and weight them by reviewer credibility
123.option_b_cn: 用一次匿名好坏票快速判断经理是否得人心
123.option_b_en: Use a single anonymous approval vote to judge the manager quickly

124.title_en: No Manager Promotion Without a Successor
124.option_a_cn: 先让继任者代理并验收交接，再放经理升任
124.option_a_en: Validate an acting successor and handover before promoting the manager
124.option_b_cn: 立即提拔明星经理，由原团队自行填补断层
124.option_b_en: Promote the star manager immediately and leave the old team to fill the gap

125.option_a_cn: 划出支持时间让下属主导一次危机，并复盘授权结果
125.option_a_en: Fund a supported subordinate-led response and review the delegation outcome
125.option_b_cn: 经理亲自接管危机，以最快恢复换取英雄声望
125.option_b_en: Have the manager seize command for the fastest recovery and visible hero credit

126.option_a_cn: 按业绩与价值观四象限分别留用、辅导、转岗或退出
126.option_a_en: Use four evidence-based quadrants for retention, coaching, transfer, or exit
126.option_b_cn: 保住所有高产者并立即清退低产者，不另审协作破坏
126.option_b_en: Retain every high producer and cut low producers without a separate conduct review

127.title_en: Span of Control and Rating Distortion
127.option_a_cn: 直管超限就增设合法负责人并补齐分层证据
127.option_a_en: Add legitimate leads and layered evidence when direct reports exceed the limit
127.option_b_cn: 维持扁平直管，由经理按期末结果一次性评分
127.option_b_en: Keep a flat structure and let one manager rate everyone from final outcomes

128.option_a_cn: 逐轮记录压力、协作、报险、互评与遗憾流失并调政策
128.option_a_en: Track pressure, collaboration, risk reporting, review trust, and regretted loss each cycle
128.option_b_cn: 维持刚性配额，只用平均 KPI 和人才密度判断成败
128.option_b_en: Keep rigid quotas and judge success only by average KPI and talent density

129.option_a_cn: 建立有期限的透明候选队列，并给轮岗或现金补偿
129.option_a_en: Maintain a time-bounded transparent queue with rotations or cash compensation
129.option_b_cn: 让主管逐年口头许诺，并为急需人选随时插队
129.option_b_en: Rely on annual verbal promises and let urgent favorites jump the queue

130.title_en: Dumping Low Performers into Other Teams
130.option_a_cn: 随转岗移交 PIP、错岗证据与限期试用条件
130.option_a_en: Transfer the PIP record, role-fit evidence, and a time-bounded trial
130.option_b_cn: 把低绩效者包装成高潜，尽快交给愿接收的团队
130.option_b_en: Rebrand the low performer as high potential and move them immediately

131.option_a_cn: 期初冻结探索或承诺标签，并写清验证点与止损线
131.option_a_en: Freeze exploration or commitment labels with validation and stop criteria up front
131.option_b_cn: 期末按结果改标签，把未兑现承诺转称探索学习
131.option_b_en: Relabel missed commitments as exploration learning at year end

132.title_en: Credit for Killing a Project in Time
132.option_a_cn: 凭不可行证据止损，冻结节省预算并由 sponsor 复核
132.option_a_en: Stop on infeasibility evidence, record saved resources, and obtain sponsor review
132.option_b_cn: 继续投入直到交付或彻底失败，以免承认沉没成本
132.option_b_en: Keep funding until delivery or collapse rather than recognize sunk cost

133.title_en: Blameless Learning and Accountability on Separate Tracks
133.option_a_cn: 先冻结事实与系统原因，再另审造假、隐瞒和失职
133.option_a_en: Freeze facts and system causes before separately judging deceit or negligence
133.option_b_cn: 事故后立即点名主责，以公开处分快速恢复秩序
133.option_b_en: Name and punish a primary culprit immediately to restore order quickly

134.title_en: Single Owner and Arbitration for Shared Metrics
134.option_a_cn: 事前登记唯一 owner、协作者、依赖和事实仲裁入口
134.option_a_en: Register one owner, contributors, dependencies, and a factual arbitration route
134.option_b_cn: 继续共担目标，结算时由上级指定领功者和责任人
134.option_b_en: Keep collective ownership and let leadership assign credit and blame at settlement

135.option_a_cn: 校准前告知暂定档与证据缺口，保留纠偏窗口
135.option_a_en: Disclose the provisional rating and evidence gaps before calibration
135.option_b_cn: 封存影子档直到终评，一次公布以避免中途争议
135.option_b_en: Withhold the shadow rating and announce it once at final review

136.option_a_cn: 只预审边界案例并留纪要，不提前分完整名额
136.option_a_en: Pre-review only boundary cases with minutes, without allocating every slot
136.option_b_cn: 小会先把各档名额分完，让正式大会快速确认
136.option_b_en: Pre-allocate all ratings privately so the formal meeting can ratify them quickly

137.option_a_cn: 随机或轮换议程，并在会前公开排序规则
137.option_a_en: Randomize or rotate the agenda under a rule published before the meeting
137.option_b_cn: 先审战略团队与亲信，趁注意力充足锁定锚点
137.option_b_en: Review strategic teams and allies first to lock anchors while attention is high

138.option_a_cn: 期初冻结最大余数与跨年轮换规则并公开尾差
138.option_a_en: Freeze maximum-remainder and cross-cycle rotation rules before ratings begin
138.option_b_cn: 看完名单后由主持人把尾差直接判给一个团队
138.option_b_en: Let the chair assign the remainder to one team after seeing the roster

139.option_a_cn: 允许借一个档位名额，但登记到期日、经理与重组责任
139.option_a_en: Allow one quota loan with an expiry, accountable manager, and reorganization liability
139.option_b_cn: 每轮刚性清零配额，不把头档或末位压力留给未来
139.option_b_en: Settle quotas rigidly every cycle and carry no rating debt forward

140.option_a_cn: 按服务天数或目标 owner 归属，并在召集令时冻结
140.option_a_en: Assign quota ownership by service days or goal owner and freeze it at convocation
140.option_b_cn: 一律由期末组织吸收全部头档与末位配额
140.option_b_en: Make the year-end organization absorb every top and bottom quota

141.option_a_cn: 只给高层一次书面必议额度，并审计理由与最终命中
141.option_a_en: Give executives one documented discussion flag and audit its rationale and accuracy
141.option_b_cn: 允许高层直接保送或必杀孙级官员，迅速结束争论
141.option_b_en: Let executives directly save or condemn skip-level staff to end debate

142.option_a_cn: 设短期待定窗与验证责任人，奖金和配额同步暂缓
142.option_a_en: Open a short pending window with a verifier and hold both pay and quota settlement
142.option_b_cn: 按截止日立即定档，迟到的里程碑统一记入下轮
142.option_b_en: Rate at the cutoff and book every late milestone into the next cycle

143.option_a_cn: 奖惩发放前按同一重大门槛对称重开一次并再封榜
143.option_a_en: Before payout, reopen once under the same materiality threshold for gains and losses
143.option_b_cn: 封榜后绝不重开，重大成功与事故都转入下一轮
143.option_b_en: Never reopen a sealed list; carry both major wins and incidents forward

144.option_a_cn: 允许实名异议附事实理由，并在翻案后回写判断信用
144.option_a_en: Record named, evidence-backed dissents and update judgment credit after appeals
144.option_b_cn: 要求全体签署共同结论，不留少数意见以便立即封账
144.option_b_en: Require unanimous sign-off with no minority record so settlement can close immediately

145.title_en: Shadow Ordering Within a Rating Band
145.option_a_cn: 公开仅用于发展的 3.5 内部顺序，并禁止影响奖金
145.option_a_en: Publish a development-only order within 3.5 and bar it from affecting pay
145.option_b_cn: 让经理私下维护 B 加减序列并据此快速分机会
145.option_b_en: Let managers keep a secret B-plus/B-minus order for allocating opportunities

146.option_a_cn: 开场直报档位，再逐项说明证据、奖惩与行动项
146.option_a_en: State the rating first, then walk through evidence, consequences, and actions
146.option_b_cn: 先用发展话术缓和关系，谈话末尾才揭示档位
146.option_b_en: Lead with development language and reveal the rating only at the end

147.option_a_cn: 允许全好或全坏，但每条判断都必须附具体证据
147.option_a_en: Permit all-positive or all-negative feedback when every judgment has evidence
147.option_b_cn: 强制每人一扬一抑，用统一模板快速交齐反馈
147.option_b_en: Force one praise and one criticism per person through a standard template

148.option_a_cn: 先逐项核对冻结案卷，再宣读已经锁定的最终档
148.option_a_en: Review the frozen record item by item before announcing the locked rating
148.option_b_cn: 先宣布档位，再用有限时间解释最关键几项事实
148.option_b_en: Announce the rating first and explain only the most important facts

149.option_a_cn: 把降档交换的补差、目标保护与转岗机会书面入账
149.option_a_en: Ledger every pay adjustment, goal protection, and transfer option exchanged for a lower rating
149.option_b_cn: 要求边界员工先接受低档，再口头承诺以后补偿
149.option_b_en: Press the boundary employee to accept the lower rating on a verbal future promise

150.option_a_cn: 把专项奖或优先机会写明 owner、期限与非预定档声明
150.option_a_en: Document the award or opportunity, owner, deadline, and non-guaranteed-rating clause
150.option_b_cn: 让员工先替团队背档，以经理个人信用口头担保下轮
150.option_b_en: Make the employee absorb the quota now on the manager's verbal guarantee

151.option_a_cn: 分别记录同意、保留异议与事实拒签，并保留送达见证
151.option_a_en: Record agreement, reserved dissent, and factual refusal separately with delivery proof
151.option_b_cn: 把任何签收都视为接受结论，并立即关闭申诉窗口
151.option_b_en: Treat any receipt as acceptance and close the appeal window immediately

152.option_a_cn: 按具体、可控、期限和资源四项让下属次轮回评
152.option_a_en: Have subordinates rate specificity, control, deadlines, and resources next cycle
152.option_b_cn: 由经理按下属是否迅速照做来判断反馈是否有效
152.option_b_en: Let managers judge feedback quality by how quickly subordinates comply

153.title_en: Closing the Loop on Feedback Actions
153.option_a_cn: 每项辅导、资源或调岗设 owner、期限与关闭凭证
153.option_a_en: Give every coaching, resource, or transfer action an owner, deadline, and closure proof
153.option_b_cn: 只留口头待办，年末由经理判断是否算已改善
153.option_b_en: Keep verbal follow-ups and let the manager decide at year end whether they were done

154.option_a_cn: 复杂案件保存逐项完整纪要，并由双方校正后签认
154.option_a_en: Keep itemized minutes for complex cases and obtain corrected sign-off from both sides
154.option_b_cn: 只记录档位和主管结论，以最少留痕快速结案
154.option_b_en: Record only the rating and manager conclusion for a fast close

155.option_a_cn: 公开头档事实与团队成果，敏感改进只在私下送达
155.option_a_en: Publish top-rating facts and team wins while delivering sensitive criticism privately
155.option_b_cn: 公开全部档位和末位问题，用群体压力推动整改
155.option_b_en: Publish every rating and bottom-tier problem to drive change through group pressure

156.option_a_cn: 向全组说明分布原则、共性问题和资源，不泄露个案
156.option_a_en: Brief the team on distribution rules, common issues, and resources without exposing cases
156.option_b_cn: 取消集体说明，只做一对一通知以尽快结束考核季
156.option_b_en: Skip the group briefing and use private notices to close the cycle quickly

157.option_a_cn: 允许合资格者自荐，但须有 sponsor 和主管书面意见
157.option_a_en: Allow eligible self-nomination with a sponsor and a written manager position
157.option_b_cn: 把晋升入口完全交给直属主管，只审其正式提名
157.option_b_en: Give direct managers exclusive control and review only their nominees

158.option_a_cn: 给少量提名额并要求排序、理由与未使用额度归还
158.option_a_en: Issue a small quota with ranking, rationale, and return of unused slots
158.option_b_cn: 把全部名额押给一名主推者，并用弱包占满余位
158.option_b_en: Concentrate every slot on one favorite and fill the rest with weak packets

159.option_a_cn: 为明星设接班计划和最迟提名日，经理获得交接资源
159.option_a_en: Set a successor plan and nomination deadline while funding the handover
159.option_b_cn: 因无人替补继续雪藏明星，优先保住本期团队产出
159.option_b_en: Keep the star shelved because no replacement exists and protect current output

160.option_a_cn: 按冻结量表预审并记录淘汰理由，让候选独立答辩
160.option_a_en: Pre-screen on a frozen rubric, record rejection reasons, and let candidates defend themselves
160.option_b_cn: 由经理闭门排出战略名单，只把最稳的人送上会
160.option_b_en: Let managers privately shortlist only the safest strategic candidates

161.option_a_cn: 只提交真正支持的候选，并向弱包本人披露胜算与成本
161.option_a_en: Submit only genuinely supported candidates and disclose odds and costs to weaker nominees
161.option_b_cn: 用陪跑包凑足竞争人数，把票源集中给主推者
161.option_b_en: Pad the slate with filler packets to concentrate votes on the favorite

162.option_a_cn: 占用有限破格额，先独立审准入再审目标级能力
162.option_a_en: Use a limited exception slot and separate eligibility review from capability review
162.option_b_cn: 在同一轮投票中为强 sponsor 的人直接豁免资历
162.option_b_en: Waive tenure inside the final vote for a candidate with a powerful sponsor

163.option_a_cn: 期初冻结两轮或本级完整履历，并统一标注重组语境
163.option_a_en: Freeze a two-cycle or full-level record and annotate reorganizations consistently
163.option_b_cn: 只取最近最强一轮，快速奖励已经显露的上升势头
163.option_b_en: Use only the strongest recent cycle to reward visible momentum quickly

164.option_a_cn: 由旧 owner 共签已验收成果，并按贡献账本拆分影响
164.option_a_en: Require the former owner to co-sign verified results and split impact by contribution ledger
164.option_b_cn: 由新主管选取最有利旧成果，直接写入当前候选包
164.option_b_en: Let the new manager select favorable old results and claim them in the current packet

165.title_en: Trial Work at the Next Level
165.option_a_cn: 授予明确权限、期限、薪酬与退出条件后再做升级试岗
165.option_a_en: Grant defined authority, duration, compensation, and exit criteria for next-level work
165.option_b_cn: 先无限加上下一级工作，等候选证明自己再谈权薪
165.option_b_en: Assign indefinite next-level work and discuss authority and pay only after proof

166.option_a_cn: 预审前允许撤包，封存已验证材料并立即释放名额
166.option_a_en: Allow pre-screen withdrawal, preserve verified material, and release the slot immediately
166.option_b_cn: 劝候选本轮硬上，以免浪费已经取得的提名窗口
166.option_b_en: Push the candidate to defend now rather than waste the nomination window

167.option_a_cn: 记录 sponsor 背书强度，并用晋升后胜任结果回写信用
167.option_a_en: Record sponsorship strength and update sponsor credit from post-promotion performance
167.option_b_cn: 让 sponsor 用声望作强力担保，帮助候选快速越过边界票
167.option_b_en: Let sponsors stake prestige on a forceful guarantee to overcome boundary votes

168.option_a_cn: 按候选难度跟踪通过、胜任和漏提，再调整经理额度
168.option_a_en: Track difficulty-adjusted passage, later performance, and omissions before changing quotas
168.option_b_cn: 按原始失败次数立刻削减低命中经理的提名额
168.option_b_en: Cut a manager's nomination quota immediately from the raw failure count

169.option_a_cn: 混合领域专家与外部评委，并事前公开两席权重
169.option_a_en: Mix domain experts with outsiders and publish their weights in advance
169.option_b_cn: 只用熟悉业务的圈内评委，迅速判断专业深度
169.option_b_en: Use only familiar insiders to judge domain depth quickly

170.option_a_cn: 从跨部门池轮换随机抽席，只允许一次有因回避
170.option_a_en: Rotate a random cross-department pool with one cause-based recusal
170.option_b_cn: 让候选团队推荐熟人占多数，减少背景解释时间
170.option_b_en: Let the candidate's team nominate a familiar majority to reduce explanation time

171.option_a_cn: 强制披露合作、HC 竞争与关系冲突，并由备选席补位
171.option_a_en: Disclose collaboration, HC competition, and personal conflicts and seat alternates
171.option_b_cn: 为免延期保留原评委，只要求其口头承诺公正
171.option_b_en: Keep conflicted panelists to avoid delay and accept verbal pledges of fairness

172.title_en: Veto, Majority Vote, or Average Score
172.option_a_cn: 普通项用去极值平均，红线否决须附理由并复核
172.option_a_en: Use trimmed averages normally and require reviewable reasons for red-line vetoes
172.option_b_cn: 授权任一评委一票否决，以最快速度守住晋升门槛
172.option_b_en: Give every panelist a unilateral veto to guard the promotion bar quickly

173.title_en: Blind Packet Review and Live Defense
173.option_a_cn: 先匿名审工件，再实名答辩并对比两阶段差异
173.option_a_en: Review artifacts blind, then hold a named defense and compare both stages
173.option_b_cn: 直接现场答辩，由评委依据表现快速决定
173.option_b_en: Move directly to a live defense and let the panel decide from performance

174.option_a_cn: 固定时长深讲一个代表案例，并保留独立质询时间
174.option_a_en: Use a fixed slot for one deep representative case and protected questioning time
174.option_b_cn: 允许堆满项目清单和长材料，以规模压缩评委质询
174.option_b_en: Allow a long project inventory that crowds out panel questioning

175.option_a_cn: 建立跨团队公共教练池，并公开有限辅导时数分配
175.option_a_en: Create a cross-team coaching pool and publish allocation of limited practice hours
175.option_b_cn: 让经理把全部模拟答辩资源押给最看好的候选
175.option_b_en: Let managers concentrate all mock-defense support on their favorite candidate

176.title_en: Separating Individual Credit from Team Results
176.option_a_cn: 冻结个人判断、动作、他人贡献与离岗后持续性证据
176.option_a_en: Freeze evidence of individual judgment, actions, others' work, and durability after departure
176.option_b_cn: 把团队结果主要记给台前 owner，迅速形成明确主功
176.option_b_en: Award most team credit to the visible owner to establish one clear hero

177.option_a_cn: 分别评分项目影响范围与候选改变打法的个人杠杆
177.option_a_en: Score project impact separately from the candidate's personal leverage on the method
177.option_b_cn: 直接用项目预算、人数与战略等级代理个人影响
177.option_b_en: Use project budget, headcount, and strategic rank as proxies for personal impact

178.option_a_cn: 要求可复核工件与口头叙事双门槛，缺一则延期
178.option_a_en: Require both verifiable artifacts and a coherent narrative, deferring incomplete packets
178.option_b_cn: 以现场故事和评委追问为主，快速判断复杂影响
178.option_b_en: Rely on the live story and questioning to judge complex impact quickly

179.option_a_cn: 每条不通过理由指定评委、差距证据与下轮验收项
179.option_a_en: Assign every rejection reason to a panelist with evidence and a next-cycle test
179.option_b_cn: 统一写准备不足，下一轮再由新评委重看整包
179.option_b_en: Record generic unreadiness and let a new panel reassess the whole packet later

180.title_en: Promotion Retry Cooldown and Packet Refresh
180.option_a_cn: 完成指定差距即可重开，保留旧结论并只补新影响
180.option_a_en: Reopen after specified gaps close, retaining old findings and adding only new impact
180.option_b_cn: 所有失败者统一冷却一整轮，不审个别改进速度
180.option_b_en: Impose a full-cycle cooldown on every failed candidate regardless of improvement

181.option_a_cn: 先分清能力、意愿、目标失真与错岗，再匹配处置
181.option_a_en: Diagnose capability, willingness, target validity, and role fit before intervention
181.option_b_cn: 见一次低档就按意愿不足启动纪律型 PIP
181.option_b_en: Treat one low rating as unwillingness and launch a disciplinary PIP

182.option_a_cn: 以严重失职或低档加已反馈问题为正式启动门槛
182.option_a_en: Require serious failure or a low rating plus previously documented problems
182.option_b_cn: 任何一次 3.25 都自动转入正式 PIP
182.option_b_en: Send every single 3.25 rating directly into a formal PIP

183.title_en: Dual-Signed PIP Goals and Refusal Reasons
183.option_a_cn: 设可控里程碑、一次修改权与独立确认并冻结拒签理由
183.option_a_en: Set controllable milestones, one revision right, independent review, and recorded refusal reasons
183.option_b_cn: 由经理单方下达目标，把拒签立即视为不服从
183.option_b_en: Let the manager impose goals unilaterally and treat refusal as insubordination

184.option_a_cn: 限制同时辅导人数，超额须配导师、错峰或上级资源
184.option_a_en: Cap concurrent PIPs and require mentors, staggered starts, or senior support above it
184.option_b_cn: 把全部低档者同批纳入 PIP，用统一期限压缩管理成本
184.option_b_en: Place every low performer into one batch PIP under a common deadline

185.option_a_cn: 中期核对进展、资源和目标有效性，只允许一次纠偏
185.option_a_en: Audit progress, resources, and goal validity midway with one controlled correction
185.option_b_cn: 取消中检，按期末最终结果一次判定毕业或失败
185.option_b_en: Skip the midpoint and decide graduation or failure only at the deadline

186.option_a_cn: 新增要求必须等量替换、延期或通过紧急复核
186.option_a_en: Require equal substitution, deadline extension, or emergency review for new demands
186.option_b_cn: 允许经理随业务变化继续加码，保持改进压力
186.option_b_en: Let managers add demands as business changes to preserve pressure

187.option_a_cn: 以关键里程碑加稳定期结业，边界案交独立复核
187.option_a_en: Graduate on key milestones plus a stability period, with independent boundary review
187.option_b_cn: 由直属经理凭最终信心决定毕业或继续观察
187.option_b_en: Let the direct manager decide graduation from final confidence

188.option_a_cn: 只观察一轮并区分同类、新问题与外部冲击后到期
188.option_a_en: Observe for one cycle, distinguish recurrence from new or external issues, then expire
188.option_b_cn: 保留长期高风险标记，任何失误都快速升级处置
188.option_b_en: Keep a long-term high-risk flag and escalate quickly after any mistake

189.option_a_cn: 核对支持、错岗与替代职位，再在二次机会、转岗和退出间选择
189.option_a_en: Compare support, role fit, and vacancies before choosing a second chance, transfer, or exit
189.option_b_cn: 首次失败或复发即结束任用，迅速释放岗位
189.option_b_en: End employment after the first failure or relapse and free the role immediately

190.option_a_cn: 只移交目标、支持、完成度、争议与本人陈述
190.option_a_en: Transfer only goals, support, completion, disputes, and the employee's statement
190.option_b_cn: 只贴低绩效标签通知接收经理，省去完整案卷审查
190.option_b_en: Send only a low-performer label to the receiving manager

191.title_en: Team Cost Statement After a PIP Exit
191.option_a_cn: 冻结补缺、交接、加班与招聘成本，并分配责任预算
191.option_a_en: Freeze vacancy, handover, overtime, and hiring costs and assign their budget owners
191.option_b_cn: 人员退出即记全额薪酬节省，不追踪团队后续负担
191.option_b_en: Book the full salary saving immediately and ignore downstream team burden

192.option_a_cn: 按能力分层轮值并允许留痕换班，同时培训后备
192.option_a_en: Use competency-tiered rotation with recorded swaps and backup training
192.option_b_cn: 把急务长期交给固定英雄，换取最快稳定响应
192.option_b_en: Keep emergencies with a permanent hero for the fastest reliable response

193.option_a_cn: 按值守时数混合发金币与调休，并设个人年度上限
193.option_a_en: Mix cash and compensatory time by duty hours under an annual personal cap
193.option_b_cn: 把值守列为岗位义务，不另付钱也不减下期任务
193.option_b_en: Treat on-call duty as inherent to the role with no extra pay or relief

194.title_en: Equal Target Relief for On-Call Work
194.option_a_cn: 按已核实急务工时等量减交付、延期限或补替班
194.option_a_en: Offset verified emergency hours with equal scope relief, extensions, or backup
194.option_b_cn: 保持原目标不变，鼓励值守者两头全扛争头档
194.option_b_en: Keep original goals and invite responders to carry both workloads for a top rating

195.option_a_cn: 由告警 owner 量化噪声、试调阈值并演练漏报风险
195.option_a_en: Have the alert owner measure noise, test thresholds, and rehearse missed-alert risk
195.option_b_cn: 立即关闭最吵的告警通道，先恢复值守专注
195.option_b_en: Silence the noisiest alert channel immediately to restore focus

196.option_a_cn: 按损失、范围和恢复时间报级，并接受独立校正
196.option_a_en: Report severity from loss, reach, and recovery time under independent correction
196.option_b_cn: 先压低事故等级保住本期绩效，扩大后再升级
196.option_b_en: Understate severity to protect current performance and escalate only if it spreads

197.title_en: Credit Split Between Incident Commander and Responder
197.option_a_cn: 按发现、决策、执行和协调时间线拆分功责
197.option_a_en: Split credit and responsibility across discovery, decisions, execution, and coordination
197.option_b_cn: 把主要救火功记给最后完成修复的台前英雄
197.option_b_en: Give the main recovery credit to the visible person who completed the fix

198.option_a_cn: 把救火功与根因过失净额结算，区分正常失败与造险
198.option_a_en: Net recovery credit against root-cause fault while separating normal failure from risk creation
198.option_b_cn: 只按恢复速度发英雄奖，根因责任另案以后再议
198.option_b_en: Award hero credit for recovery speed and defer root-cause responsibility

199.title_en: Credit for Prevention When Nothing Breaks
199.option_a_cn: 对被采纳防护设观察期，以后续无事故发有限延迟功
199.option_a_en: Observe adopted safeguards and grant capped delayed credit after an incident-free period
199.option_b_cn: 只奖励真实事故中的可见救火，不给未发生风险计功
199.option_b_en: Reward only visible response to real incidents and give no credit for non-events

200.option_a_cn: 授予限时、限范围的越权权限，并保留命令日志与事后复核
200.option_a_en: Grant time- and scope-limited emergency powers with command logs and after-action review
200.option_b_cn: 危机期间开放全面越权，先恢复再补审批
200.option_b_en: Allow unrestricted overrides during the crisis and seek approval after recovery

201.option_a_cn: 事故开始即冻结发现、升级、命令、行动和恢复节点
201.option_a_en: Freeze discovery, escalation, commands, actions, and recovery nodes from incident start
201.option_b_cn: 恢复后由指挥官整理一份精简时间线并删除过程噪声
201.option_b_en: Let the commander produce a concise post-recovery timeline and remove process noise

202.option_a_cn: 每项修复指定唯一 owner、支持者、期限和独立验收人
202.option_a_en: Give each fix one owner, named supporters, a deadline, and an independent verifier
202.option_b_cn: 把所有改进愿望列入复盘，由团队按空闲自行认领
202.option_b_en: List every desired improvement and let the team claim items when free

203.option_a_cn: 区分未做、无效、资源被拒和新根因，再追到资源决策层
203.option_a_en: Distinguish undone, ineffective, unfunded, and novel causes before escalating to resource owners
203.option_b_cn: 同类事故复发就加罚当班人员，以高压阻止第三次
203.option_b_en: Punish the current responders after a repeat incident to deter a third occurrence

204.option_a_cn: 耗尽可靠性预算即暂停部分新项目，修复到书面门槛
204.option_a_en: Pause selected launches when the reliability budget is exhausted until a written recovery threshold
204.option_b_cn: 由高层签字继续冲刺，把后续事故损失归入其决策账
204.option_b_en: Let leadership sign to continue shipping and own the resulting incident losses

205.option_a_cn: 冻结重复运维工时，超限就自动化、停接或补人
205.option_a_en: Measure repetitive operations and automate, stop intake, or add staff above the cap
205.option_b_cn: 维持手工吞吐以保住本期交付，暂不计算隐形工时
205.option_b_en: Keep manual throughput to protect current delivery and leave hidden hours uncounted

206.option_a_cn: 为每笔赶工记录省时本金、维护利息、风险和责任 owner
206.option_a_en: Record saved-time principal, maintenance interest, risk, and owner for every shortcut
206.option_b_cn: 只记录按时上线成果，把后续维护作为新团队日常工作
206.option_b_en: Record only the on-time launch and treat later maintenance as ordinary new-team work

207.option_a_cn: 每轮锁定偿债人力，并以风险下降验收而非功能数
207.option_a_en: Ring-fence debt capacity each cycle and accept it by risk reduction, not feature count
207.option_b_cn: 业务高压时收回全部还债人力，集中完成显性指标
207.option_b_en: Reclaim all debt capacity during business pressure to maximize visible targets

208.option_a_cn: 按风险分段修补并设可量化退出线，逐步替换旧务
208.option_a_en: Repair by risk segment with measurable exit gates and gradual replacement
208.option_b_cn: 宣布全面重做并冻结旧系统演进，押注一次性切换
208.option_b_en: Freeze legacy evolution and bet on a single big-bang rewrite

209.option_a_cn: 为积弊岗位提供限期金币、晋升证据或轮值减免
209.option_a_en: Offer time-limited cash, promotion evidence, or rotation relief for hazardous legacy work
209.option_b_cn: 强派最弱势员工接手旧务，以最低成本补上空缺
209.option_b_en: Assign the least powerful employee to fill the legacy role at minimum cost

210.option_a_cn: 定期轮换 owner，并为每次轮换配置交接与实操培训
210.option_a_en: Rotate owners on schedule with handover and practical training every time
210.option_b_cn: 让最高效专家永久负责，靠个人熟练度维持速度
210.option_b_en: Keep the most efficient expert permanently responsible to preserve speed

211.option_a_cn: 让新人按手册完成一次实操验收后再给作者计功
211.option_a_en: Credit the author only after a newcomer completes a practical run from the manual
211.option_b_cn: 继续由专家口传心授，避免写作拖慢当前交付
211.option_b_en: Keep expert oral apprenticeship so writing does not delay current delivery

212.option_a_cn: 按未来节省工时、故障与交接难度给自动化延迟计功
212.option_a_en: Credit automation from future hours, incidents, and handover difficulty it removes
212.option_b_cn: 继续按当期处理件数发绩效，让可见吞吐优先
212.option_b_en: Continue rewarding current ticket counts and prioritize visible throughput

213.option_a_cn: 同时记录审阅拦错、投入工时与阻塞时长，设周转目标
213.option_a_en: Record defects prevented, reviewer time, and blocking delay under a turnaround target
213.option_b_cn: 只给亲自交付者计功，要求审阅者尽快批准避免阻塞
213.option_b_en: Credit only authors and press reviewers to approve quickly to avoid delay

214.option_a_cn: 围绕高风险场景做深测，并用真实事故反校验证选择
214.option_a_en: Test deeply around documented risks and recalibrate selection from real incidents
214.option_b_cn: 设检查数量和覆盖率硬线，月底集中补齐数字
214.option_b_en: Set hard test-count and coverage targets and fill the numbers at month end

215.option_a_cn: 先迁移剩余用户、开放必要性申诉，再验收退役节省
215.option_a_en: Migrate remaining users, hear necessity appeals, and verify savings before retirement
215.option_b_cn: 立即关闭低使用旧务，把释放 HC 当期计入交付
215.option_b_en: Shut down low-use legacy services immediately and book the freed HC now

216.option_a_cn: 给交接时间并按资产、风险、联系人和未结项逐项验收
216.option_a_en: Fund handover time and verify assets, risks, contacts, and open work item by item
216.option_b_cn: 立即放人到新岗，把遗留问题交给接任者边做边查
216.option_b_en: Release the employee immediately and let the successor discover gaps on the job

217.option_a_cn: 只强制底线接口，其余能力凭试点价值争取采用
217.option_a_en: Mandate only baseline interfaces and earn broader adoption through measured pilots
217.option_b_cn: 命令所有团队一次切到统一平台，迅速消灭重复建设
217.option_b_en: Order every team onto one platform at once to eliminate duplication quickly

218.title_en: Internal Customer and Strategic Foundation Dual Score
218.option_a_cn: 客户体验与战略底座各设最低线，共同进入校准
218.option_a_en: Set minimum bars for customer experience and strategic foundations and calibrate both
218.option_b_cn: 让最大内部客户一票决定平台绩效，优先解决眼前痛点
218.option_b_en: Let the largest internal customer determine the rating and prioritize immediate pain

219.title_en: Adoption Count, Usage Depth, and Savings
219.option_a_cn: 至少绑定一个真实节省结果和一个反指标，再看接入深度
219.option_a_en: Require one real savings outcome and one counter-metric before judging usage depth
219.option_b_cn: 以接入团队数为主指标，集中推动大量浅接入
219.option_b_en: Use connected-team count as the main target and drive broad shallow adoption

220.option_a_cn: 先展示成本，再按可核使用量分摊大户并核对国库守恒
220.option_a_en: Show costs first, then charge material users by measured consumption with treasury reconciliation
220.option_b_cn: 由中央国库全包平台费用，以零门槛迅速扩大采用
220.option_b_en: Fund the platform centrally and remove price barriers to accelerate adoption

221.option_a_cn: 按未来受益比例冻结平台、使用方和改革预算的出资额
221.option_a_en: Freeze platform, user-team, and reform funding shares by expected benefit
221.option_b_cn: 要求使用团队自付全部迁移 HC，以此检验真实需求
221.option_b_en: Make user teams pay all migration HC to prove genuine demand

222.option_a_cn: 按风险分批双跑，并为旧路设明确退出日和额外工时
222.option_a_en: Dual-run by risk tier with a firm legacy exit date and explicit extra labor
222.option_b_cn: 在统一日期立即切换，停止旧路以强迫问题快速暴露
222.option_b_en: Cut over on one date and disable the old path to expose problems quickly

223.option_a_cn: 立项前检索复用、贡献改造与差异例外并留审批证据
223.option_a_en: Search for reuse, upstream contribution, and documented exceptions before approval
223.option_b_cn: 为关键项目快速批准自建，避免等待共享方案协调
223.option_b_en: Approve a bespoke build for critical work rather than wait for shared coordination

224.option_a_cn: 用公开试点选主线，保留双方贡献并资助必要重构
224.option_a_en: Choose a mainline through a public pilot, preserve both credits, and fund required refactoring
224.option_b_cn: 由高层立即指定唯一胜者，并停止另一方案维护
224.option_b_en: Have leadership choose one winner immediately and stop maintaining the other solution

225.option_a_cn: 先向主线提交改动，只有硬差异获批才分叉并自负维护
225.option_a_en: Contribute upstream first and fork only for approved hard requirements with owned maintenance
225.option_b_cn: 为本地速度立即分叉，之后再决定是否回馈主线
225.option_b_en: Fork immediately for local speed and decide about upstreaming later

226.option_a_cn: 按采纳修复、文档和能力给贡献者及审阅维护者双记功
226.option_a_en: Credit accepted fixes, docs, and features to contributors and reviewing maintainers
226.option_b_cn: 按提交数量快速合并外组贡献，以活跃度扩大社区
226.option_b_en: Merge external contributions rapidly by submission count to grow community activity

227.title_en: Splitting Credit Among Founders, Contributors, and Maintainers
227.option_a_cn: 分别冻结原创、扩展与稳定贡献，并让创始光环逐期衰减
227.option_a_en: Freeze invention, extension, and stability credit separately and decay founder halo over time
227.option_b_cn: 把平台成功主要记给创始 owner，以明确单一晋升故事
227.option_b_en: Give most platform success to the founding owner for one clear promotion story

228.option_a_cn: 区分平台根因、用户违规和强推决策，并允许本地降级止损
228.option_a_en: Separate platform causes, user violations, and mandate decisions while allowing local degradation
228.option_b_cn: 强撑统一平台并把损失归给未按规范使用的各团队
228.option_b_en: Enforce platform uniformity and charge losses to teams that deviated from prescribed use

229.option_a_cn: 登记定义、来源、频率、范围、唯一 owner 与版本变更理由
229.option_a_en: Register definition, source, cadence, scope, one owner, and reasons for every version change
229.option_b_cn: 由业务主管快速宣布本期口径，先完成统一计算
229.option_b_en: Let the business lead declare the current definition so calculation can proceed immediately

230.option_a_cn: 冲突时暂停结算，由多方签名核对并确定权威源
230.option_a_en: Pause settlement on conflict and reconcile a signed authoritative source across owners
230.option_b_cn: 立即选一份官方报表结算，其他差异留待后续审计
230.option_b_en: Settle from one official report immediately and defer discrepancies to audit

231.option_a_cn: 并列展示新旧分母、重算基线且不追改旧奖金
231.option_a_en: Show old and new denominators, rebase forward, and leave paid bonuses untouched
231.option_b_cn: 立即采用更有利的新分母，并用它重述本期增长
231.option_b_en: Adopt the more favorable denominator immediately and restate current growth

232.option_a_cn: 用保守估计或人工凭证双签，并在真数到达后对账
232.option_a_en: Use conservative estimates or dual-signed evidence and reconcile when real data arrives
232.option_b_cn: 由单一主管快速回填最合理数字，避免延期发奖
232.option_b_en: Let one manager backfill the most plausible number to avoid delaying rewards

233.option_a_cn: 按岗位开放看板，并给无权限者查询渠道与目标调整
233.option_a_en: Grant role-based dashboard access plus query channels and target relief for excluded staff
233.option_b_cn: 只给经理完整数据，仍要求下属对异常结果负责
233.option_b_en: Reserve full data for managers while holding staff accountable for anomalies

234.option_a_cn: 同时冻结领先信号与滞后结果，暂定认可到期再转正
234.option_a_en: Freeze leading and lagging measures together and convert provisional credit at maturity
234.option_b_cn: 结果未成熟时先按领先指标发奖，以加快行为转向
234.option_b_en: Reward leading indicators before outcomes mature to accelerate behavior change

235.option_a_cn: 每个主指标绑定一项护栏，突破须书面批准并追延迟后果
235.option_a_en: Pair every primary metric with a guardrail and track delayed effects of written exceptions
235.option_b_cn: 危机期只追主指标，先拿结果再处理民心与质量
235.option_b_en: Chase only the primary metric during crisis and repair quality or trust later

236.option_a_cn: 用连续区间计分并保留关键底线，期初冻结斜率
236.option_a_en: Use continuous scoring with a critical floor and freeze the slope up front
236.option_b_cn: 坚持百分百硬门槛，让未达标者统一承受完整后果
236.option_b_en: Keep a 100-percent cliff and impose full consequences on every miss

237.title_en: Window Shopping for the Best-Looking Period
237.option_a_cn: 期初指定完整周期、同比或里程碑窗，并统一修正季节性
237.option_a_en: Pre-register full-cycle, year-over-year, or milestone windows with consistent seasonality adjustment
237.option_b_cn: 允许 owner 选最能代表成果的高峰时段来汇报
237.option_b_en: Let owners present the peak period they believe best represents the result

238.option_a_cn: 把访问、活动或文件数绑定真实采用、节省或治理结果
238.option_a_en: Tie visits, activities, or document counts to adoption, savings, or governance outcomes
238.option_b_cn: 先按快速上涨的可见数字计功，价值转化以后再看
238.option_b_en: Credit fast-rising visible counts now and evaluate value conversion later

239.option_a_cn: 预注册假设与止损线，负结果须形成可复用结论才计功
239.option_a_en: Pre-register hypotheses and stop rules and credit negative results only when reusable
239.option_b_cn: 为挽回投入继续上线未达标方案，用真实采用争取翻盘
239.option_b_en: Ship the failed variant anyway and seek redemption through real adoption
